Add a payment source: payments taken outside the stores, such as another payment provider, bank
transfers or vouchers, reported by your backend.

Each endpoint gets a signing secret, shown once: with --json or --quiet it goes to standard error.

Usage:
  voidhash provider connect payment-source [flags]

Flags:
      --endpoint <url>       The HTTPS endpoint url of its server's Voidhash provider handler, for
                             product lists, history imports, refunds and cancellations
  -h, --help                 Show help for this command
      --json                 Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>          What people see, such as Paddle or Bank transfer
      --project <project>    Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                             this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                Print only ids, one per line
      --slug <slug>          How webhooks, analytics and the API name it (default: made from the
                             name); it cannot change
      --test-endpoint <url>  Another endpoint url for test requests only, such as a staging
                             server's; without it test requests go to --endpoint

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash provider connect payment-source --name "Bank transfer"
  voidhash provider connect payment-source --name Paddle --endpoint https://pay.example.com/voidhash
